"ReGroup and ReLoad"
Warm up: Light KB Swings 5 sets of 10 reps
* 75 sec rest between sets
1. Back Squat "unbroken" 1 set of 10 reps @ 55%
2. Front Squat "unbroken" 1 set of 8 reps @ 35-40% of back squat max
3. BB Bulgarian Split Squats "Unbroken" 1 set of 5 reps each leg
* 90 sec rest between each exercise
4. Deadlift 4 reps @ 65%, 70%, 75%, 75%
* 2 min rest between sets * No Bouncing
5. a. KB Swings 5 sets of 10 reps
super set b. DB Laterals 5 sets of 15 reps
* 75 sec rest between each super set
Recovery: Cardio · MeatLover's Pizza · Eat an extra slice · 30 min Walk · 8-9 hrs Sleep
